description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing password preferences and validation policies in the Fineract user administration module. It includes endpoints for retrieving current password policies, updating preferences, and listing available validation policies.

classes.name: PasswordPreferencesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for password preferences management, including retrieval, update, and listing validation policies.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current password validation policy data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update password preferences based on provided JSON input.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all available password validation policies.
